model.name: FeatureManager.bootstrapSeed
model.description: bootstrapSeed(): at first run, idempotent-seeds FeatureManager.allowedUsers=[OWNER_TOKEN] AND ServerManager.allowedUsers=[OWNER_TOKEN] from the hardcoded OWNER_TOKEN (Tron) — the bootstrap root-of-trust. From there Tron grants everyone else via FeatureManager; NO grant path exists that doesn't originate at the hardcoded owner. INV-G2: OWNER_TOKEN literal ==1 preserved (used ONLY here + the root-of-trust gate). INV-F5: empty/malformed allowedUsers FAILS CLOSED. Idempotent (safe to re-run). LOAD-BEARING marked decl.
